trends.title: TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 200 nominations are still open
trends.summary: Nominate your startup, or one you know, for TechCrunch Startup Battlefield 200 before May 27. Chance to win $100,000 equity-free funding and VC access.

trends.title: Jeff Bezos reportedly wants $100 billion to buy and transform old manufacturing firms with AI
trends.summary: The Amazon magnate has a new project centered around acquiring industrial firms and revamping them with AI technology.

trends.title: Meta rolls out new AI content enforcement systems while reducing reliance on third-party vendors
trends.summary: Meta believes these AI systems can detect more violations with greater accuracy, better prevent scams, respond more quickly to real-world events, and reduce over-enforcement.

trends.title: DoorDash launches a new ‘Tasks’ app that pays couriers to submit videos to train AI
trends.summary: Delivery couriers will be able to earn money by completing activities like filming everyday tasks or recording themselves speaking in another language.

trends.title: Multiverse Computing pushes its compressed AI models into the mainstream
trends.summary: After compressing models from major AI labs, including OpenAI, Meta, DeepSeek, and Mistral AI, Multiverse Computing has launched both an app that showcases the capabilities of its compressed models and an API that makes them more widely available.

trends.title: Meta is having trouble with rogue AI agents
trends.summary: A rogue AI agent inadvertently exposed Meta company and user data to engineers who didn't have permission to see it.

trends.title: Nothing CEO Carl Pei says smartphone apps will disappear as AI agents take their place
trends.summary: Nothing CEO Carl Pei says AI agents will eventually replace apps, shifting smartphones toward systems that understand intent and act on a user's behalf.

trends.title: Generative AI improves a wireless vision system that sees through obstructions
trends.summary: With this new technique, a robot could more accurately detect hidden objects or understand an indoor scene using reflected Wi-Fi signals.

trends.title: Sustaining diplomacy amid competition in US-China relations
trends.summary: At MIT, former U.S. ambassador to China Nicholas Burns highlights climate change as an area for diplomatic engagement, while exploring areas including China's emphasis on STEM education.

trends.title: MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab seed to signal: Amplifying early-career faculty impact
trends.summary: Academia-industry relationship is an early-stage accelerator, supporting professional progress and research.

trends.title: Can AI help predict which heart-failure patients will worsen within a year?
trends.summary: Researchers at MIT, Mass General Brigham, and Harvard Medical School developed a deep-learning model to forecast a patient’s heart failure prognosis up to a year in advance.

trends.title: 3 Questions: On the future of AI and the mathematical and physical sciences
trends.summary: Professor Jesse Thaler describes a vision for a two-way bridge between artificial intelligence and the mathematical and physical sciences — one that promises to advance both.

trends.title: Online bot traffic will exceed human traffic by 2027, Cloudflare CEO says
trends.summary: AI bots may outnumber humans online by 2027, says Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince, as generative AI agents dramatically increase web traffic and infrastructure demands.

trends.title: Amazon brings Alexa+ to the UK
trends.summary: The company is currently letting users in the U.K. try out Alexa+ for free via an early access program.

trends.title: Sam Altman’s thank-you to coders draws the memes
trends.summary: Altman expresses gratitude for people who knew how to write their code from scratch. The internet replies with salty jokes.

trends.title: A better method for identifying overconfident large language models
trends.summary: This new metric for measuring uncertainty could flag hallucinations and help users know whether to trust an AI model.

trends.title: New MIT class uses anthropology to improve chatbots
trends.summary: MIT computer science students design AI chatbots to help young users become more social, and socially confident.

trends.title: A better method for planning complex visual tasks
trends.summary: A new hybrid system could help robots navigate in changing environments or increase the efficiency of multirobot assembly teams.

trends.title: 3 Questions: Building predictive models to characterize tumor progression
trends.summary: Assistant Professor Matthew Jones is working to decode molecular processes on the genetic, epigenetic, and microenvironment levels to anticipate how and when tumors evolve to resist treatment.

trends.title: How Joseph Paradiso’s sensing innovations bridge the arts, medicine, and ecology
trends.summary: From early motion-sensing platforms to environmental monitoring, the professor and head of the Program in Media Arts and Sciences has turned decades of cross-disciplinary research into real-world impact.
